_comment: Every UI string of the app. Edit text here, never in code. {name} is a placeholder filled by code. Names, versions and authors of maps are data (srl-practice's catalogue), of practice tools too (practice.json).
practice.title: Practice
settings.title: Settings
settings.disclaimer: NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.
map.the-mcsr-practice-map-dibedy: Every split in one world, from the Overworld to the dragon fight.
map.llama-s-bastion-practice-llamapag: All bastion types with their common routes.
map.portal-practice-v2-semperzz: Building nether portals from lava pools and ruined portals.
map.portal-practice-mescht: Building nether portals, with saved loadouts and PBs.
map.bt-practice-mescht: Finding buried treasure without a map.
map.blaze-practice-mescht: Blaze spawners in different fortress layouts.
map.blaze-practice-semperzz: Open and closed spawners, double spawners too, with three loadouts to cycle.
map.end-portal-fill-v2-cylorun: Filling the end portal frame quickly.
map.zero-sorting-practice-semperzz: Sorting your inventory before a zero-cycle.
ptool.minipracticekit: Command-block kit with presets for every split. Also works in your Ranked setup.
ptool.peepopractice: Split practice mod with a loadout editor and custom categories.
ptool.strongholdtrainer: Stronghold navigation with timing and feedback.

name.title: Pick a name
name.body_msa: Your name when you play offline. You sign in with Microsoft once before your first game.
import.title: Import your settings
import.body: Replaces this launcher's settings and keeps a backup. Nothing changes in the other launcher.
import.picked_nothing: Nothing to import in {path}. Choose an instance's folder or its .minecraft.
import.picked_own: That's this launcher's folder. Choose the other launcher's.
import.options_hint: Keys, mouse sensitivity, FOV, video, sound
import.note_draftout: Draftout runs Minecraft 26.3, so it gets only your keys, mouse sensitivity and FOV.
import.note_from_draftout: This instance runs Minecraft 26.3. Draftout gets everything; Speedrun and Practice maps get only your keys, mouse sensitivity and FOV.
import.button_wait: close the game and wait for downloads
import.done_busy: {modes} stayed as they were, because the game was running or installing. Import again once it's done.
import.done_worlds_kept: {n} worlds were there already and stayed as they were.
import.done_worlds_kept_one: {n} world was there already and stayed as it was.
import.done_unchanged: Everything was the same already, so nothing changed.
settings.import_hint: From MultiMC, Prism Launcher, MCSR Launcher or the Minecraft Launcher.
data.title: The data folder can't be written
data.hint: Check that the drive is connected and the folder isn't read-only, then start the app again. To use another folder, set SRL_HOME to it.
tool.ninjabrain-bot.what: Finds the stronghold from your Eye of Ender throws. Copy each throw with F3+C.
tool.toolscreen.what: Instant resizing, eye zoom for measuring throws, and overlays such as Ninjabrain Bot.
tool.waywall.what: Resizing, eye zoom, key remaps and a Ninjabrain Bot overlay, with the game in its own Wayland window.
tool.note.banned: {tool} is not allowed in this mode
tool.note.not_supported: {tool} isn't set up for this mode yet
tool.note.unverified: {tool} was left out: its files don't match the expected download. Reinstall it in Tools
tool.note.no_wayland: waywall needs a Wayland session, so the game starts without it
tool.note.no_glfw: waywall needs its patched GLFW for 1.16.1 (see waywall's setup guide), so the game starts without it
tool.note.glfw_not_legal: The GLFW at {path} isn't on the legal list, so runs with it may be rejected
tool.note.glfw_unchecked: Couldn't check the GLFW at {path}, because the legal list couldn't be downloaded
v3.fail.exit_signal: The system ended Minecraft, often because memory ran out.
settings.accessibility_hint: Adds Extra Options (FOV and distortion sliders) to Speedrun. Allowed in runs only if you need it.
settings.draftout_extras_hint: Removes chat restrictions and turns off telemetry.
settings.data_folder_hint: Logs, the trash and everything the launcher installs.
settings.update_wait_game: Restart once the game is closed.
settings.update_wait_install: Restart once installing or importing has finished.
settings.update_rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again in an hour.
settings.update_checksum: The download was damaged, so it was deleted. Try again later.
settings.update_failed: The update failed. Try again, or download it from the Releases page.
settings.update_local: A local build doesn't update itself.
settings.update_platform: Download new versions from the Releases page.
settings.auto_update: Check for updates on every start

tools.title: Tools
tools.not_ready_draftout: Not set up for Draftout yet.
tools.system_install: Install waywall and its patched GLFW from its GitHub page.
tools.glfw_missing: Its patched GLFW isn't installed, so 1.16.1 would start without waywall. See waywall's setup guide on GitHub.
learn.title: Learn
learn.topic.setup.desc: Set the game up the way runners do, learn the rules and submit your first run.
learn.topic.eyes.desc: Finding the stronghold with Ninjabrain Bot: eye throws, boat eye and the zoom tools.
learn.g.draconix-setup: The whole setup: mods, Java, SeedQueue, boat eye, Toolscreen, OBS and submitting.
learn.g.couriway-guide: A whole run explained, from the Overworld to the dragon.
learn.g.mikeyboie-guide: Setup, then the Overworld, bastions, fortress, stronghold and the End.
learn.g.src-rules: What a run may use: settings, keybinds, macros and mods.
learn.g.src-tools: Which third-party tools runs may use, with download links.
learn.g.sq-video: The mod explained by its author.
learn.g.sq-wiki: Configuration, customising the wall and troubleshooting.
learn.g.sq-settings: Suggests SeedQueue settings for your PC.
learn.g.java-guide: Which Java to run the game on, and with which arguments.
learn.g.fsg-mod: Picking a seed filter for FSG, and using it with SeedQueue.
learn.g.jingle: For single-instance play: borderless window, plugins, OBS and packing a run for submission.
learn.g.hitrippy-4routes: One route per bastion type, enough to start with.
learn.g.nb-boat: The official boat eye page: settings and sensitivity values.
learn.g.nb-readme: Ninjabrain Bot's hotkeys, settings and how it calculates.
learn.g.hitrippy-preemptive: Preemptive navigation with the pie chart.
learn.g.mimi-preemptive: How strongholds generate and what that means for navigation, in depth.
learn.g.ranked-explanations: Top players explain each bastion type, the fortress and the stronghold.
learn.g.draftout-playing: Scoring, time limits and Competitive matches.
learn.g.draftout-drafting: Choosing the board's goals with your opponent while you scout the seed.
learn.g.draftout-rules: Including the speedrun tools Draftout bans.

auth.title: Microsoft account
auth.why: Needed once before your first game, and for every Ranked or Draftout match. Use an account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.
auth.browser_hint: Sign in on the Microsoft page that just opened.
auth.browser_not_opened: No browser opened. Copy this link into one:
auth.device_hint: Scan the code, or open {url} and enter:
auth.renew_warning: Couldn't renew the sign-in. It works until {time}; sign in again in Settings before then.
auth.error.not_available: This version can't sign in to Microsoft yet, so Ranked and Draftout matches won't connect.
auth.error.timed_out: The sign-in timed out. Start it again when you're ready.
auth.error.device_code_expired: The code expired before it was used. Start the sign-in again for a new one.
auth.error.state_mismatch: The browser returned a sign-in the launcher didn't start. Start the sign-in again.
auth.error.app_misconfigured: Sign-in is broken in this version. Check for an update in Settings.
auth.error.relogin_required: Your Microsoft sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
auth.error.xbox_no_account: This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile yet. Sign in once at xbox.com (or minecraft.net) to create one, then try again.
auth.error.xbox_country: Xbox Live isn't available in this account's region, so it can't sign in to Minecraft. A VPN won't help.
auth.error.xbox_age_verification: This account needs age verification (required in South Korea) or has reached its playtime limit. Verify at login.live.com, then try again.
auth.error.xbox_child_account: This is a child account (under 18). An adult must add it to a Microsoft family before it can play online.
auth.error.xbox_banned: This account is banned from Xbox Live, so it cannot sign in to Minecraft.
auth.error.xbox_guardian: A parent or guardian has not allowed online play for this account. They can change it at account.microsoft.com/family.
auth.error.xbox_terms: This account has not accepted the Xbox terms of use yet. Sign in once at xbox.com, accept them, then try again.
auth.error.client_not_approved: Mojang hasn't approved this launcher for Microsoft sign-in yet. Check for an update in Settings.
auth.error.not_owned: This Microsoft account doesn't own Minecraft: Java Edition. If you play through PC Game Pass, start the game once in the official Minecraft Launcher, then try again.
auth.error.game_pass_no_profile: This account has Minecraft through PC Game Pass but no Minecraft profile yet. Start the game once in the official Minecraft Launcher (or pick a name at minecraft.net), then try again.
auth.error.no_profile: This account owns Minecraft but has no profile name yet. Pick one at minecraft.net, then try again.
auth.error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in requests. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.error.network: Couldn't reach the sign-in servers. Check your internet connection.
auth.error.service: The sign-in service answered with an error. Try again later.
auth.error.keystore: The system keyring is locked or not answering. Unlock it and try again, or sign out of every account in Settings and sign in again.
auth.error.storage: Couldn't save or read the account list. Check that the data folder can be written, then try again.
auth.error.unknown_account: This account isn't on the list any more.
v3.fail.sign_in_first: Use an account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.
settings.player_hint: Your name when you play offline.
auth.logged_in_hint: Every mode now starts with this account.
auth.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in…
auth.device_unavailable: The phone code isn't available right now. Use the browser.
map.vine-ssg-practice-bdamja: Overworld, Nether and portal splits of the Vine seed, with timers.
practice.play_busy: In the running game's Singleplayer list
practice.worlds_deleted: world deleted · Install puts it back
practice.in_game_any: Open Singleplayer, then the map's world.
practice.game_busy: Close the game to reset, update or delete a map.
practice.req.carpet: Carpet resets saturation and shortens the wait before each bastion run. Put its .jar in Instances › Practice maps › Open folder › mods.
practice.req.lbp-extensions: LBP Extensions by awesome-03 adds save states and more. Put its .jar in Instances › Practice maps › Open folder › mods.
practice.req.render-distance-16: If the inventory doesn't load, raise the render distance; the author recommends 16.
practice.req.autocraftable: AutoCraftable by RedLime closes the recipe book after each craft. Put its .jar in Instances › Practice maps › Open folder › mods.
practice.req.world-grows-large: The world grows as you practise. To shrink it, delete the region folder in its world (Instances › Practice maps › Worlds › Open folder); records and settings stay.
practice.req.spawning-potential-lag: The spawning-potential view can lag on weaker computers; turn it off in the map or lower its resolution.
practice.req.playerattribute: playerattribute by RedLime (in the map's release) makes the hunger and health reset work. Put its .jar in Instances › Practice maps › Open folder › mods.
practice.req.entity-distance-175: Set entity distance to 175% to match the preemptive navigation videos.
practice.link.other-minecraft-version: Made for Minecraft {mc}, which this launcher doesn't run. Play it in another launcher; it's on the author's page.
practice.link.no-direct-download: Download it from the author's page, unzip the world into Instances › Practice maps › Worlds › Open saves folder, then press Play.
practice.link.author-opt-out: The author asks that you download it from their page. Unzip the world into Instances › Practice maps › Worlds › Open saves folder, then press Play.
practice.credit.the-mcsr-practice-map-di: Bundles Mescht's portal, zero, search-crafting and fortress practice and LlamaPag's bastion practice.
practice.credit.ow-practice-7rowl: Command blocks and rooms by Semperzz, crafting practice by Angelohasleft, testing by GNG and Ravalle.
practice.credit.crafting-practice-v2-sem: Inspired by Fyroah's original crafting map, with ideas and feedback from Bugbu6.
practice.fail.network: Couldn't download. Check the connection and try again.

practice.fail.hash: The download didn't match the expected file, so nothing was installed. Try again later.
practice.fail.not_a_world: This download isn't a world the launcher can install.
practice.fail.world_in_use: The map is open in the game. Leave the world (Save and Quit to Title), then try again.
practice.game_fail.offline: No internet connection, and the Practice maps instance isn't installed yet.
practice.game_fail.offline_update: No internet connection, so the Practice maps instance couldn't download its missing files.
practice.game_fail.install: The Practice maps instance couldn't be installed.
practice.game_fail.launch: Minecraft closed while the Practice maps instance was starting.
practice.tools_later: Practice mods install in a later version.

practice.ask.update.replace_hint: Your progress in the old world is lost.
practice.ask.update.both_hint: v{v} installs next to it; the old world stays as it is.
practice.ask.remove.title: Delete {map}?
practice.ask.remove.kept: Worlds you kept from an earlier version stay: {worlds}.
mods.not_legal: A run with these mods won't count for {mode}:
mods.concern.not_legal: {name} isn't on the legal mod list
mods.concern.unknown: {name} is your own jar, not on any legal list
v3.sibling_busy: {other} is running on the same instance. Close it first.

mods.desc.antiresourcereload: Skips the resource reload when a world is created.
mods.desc.atum: Resets to a new world with one key.
mods.desc.boundlesswindow: Removes the macOS title bar, so the window can be any height.
mods.desc.chunkumulator: Sends chunks to the player in batches, so worlds load faster.
mods.desc.dynamicmenufps: Lowers the frame rate in menus and in the background.
mods.desc.extra-options: 1.16.2's sliders that tone down FOV and distortion effects.
mods.desc.fast_reset: Skips saving the world when you reset.
mods.desc.forceport: Fixes the Open to LAN port and raises its player limit.
mods.desc.hermes: Writes the run's state for outside tools.
mods.desc.lazystronghold: Generates strongholds faster, in the background.
mods.desc.lithium: Faster game logic that plays like vanilla.
mods.desc.planifolia: The vanilla video settings screen, with Sodium.
mods.desc.retino: Renders at half resolution on Retina displays, for more frames.
mods.desc.seedqueue: Generates worlds in the background, so you reset faster.
mods.desc.setspawnmod: Sets your spawn point for set-seed runs.
mods.desc.sleepbackground: Lets instances in the background sleep, to save resources.
mods.desc.speedrunigt: The in-game timer, with RTA and IGT.
mods.desc.standardsettings: Resets your settings to a set default at the start of each run.
mods.desc.starlight: A rewritten light engine, faster and with fewer lighting bugs.
mods.desc.state-output: Writes the game state to a file for tools, so they work without WorldPreview.
mods.desc.voyager: Fixes a rare crash on newer Java versions.
mods.desc.worldpreview: Shows the world while it generates.
mods.desc.custom-map-resetter: Resets custom maps from a saved copy and counts attempts.
mods.desc.fsg-mod: Picks a filtered seed for Atum.
mods.desc.peepopractice: Split practice with loadouts and custom categories.
mods.desc.nochatrestrictions: Removes the chat and multiplayer restrictions.
mods.desc.commandqmod: On macOS, Command + drop throws the whole stack.
